name: Tử Điện, Purple Lightning (Tử Điện Kiếm)
lore: One of the twin swords Lạc Hà forged for its armoury in 360, after the purple lightning and blue frost of an old general's blades (C083). The bay city was renamed for it in 620 (C128). Each head takes it at the headship (C191). No head has had Thunder, so for 840 years the sect has worn a lightning sword that does not wake. Legendary item tu_dien.

name: Lone Duck Ring (Cô Vụ Giới)
lore: The founder's ring, a wild duck cut in grey steppe jade. It is the key to the treasury arrays. In 1179 Tô Vãn Chiếu pledged it to Phan Vật Hoa of Thiên Bảo Trai as surety for the loan that paid for the Cloud Bridge (N-lac_ha-03). The ring now sits in Thiên Bảo Trai's vault, so the sect cannot open its own treasury without its vassal's leave. Only the head, the first elder, the Counting House master and Phan Vật Hoa know this.
build_use: Thần thức and a ward; a treasury key first.
